entities.summary: Roman Volodymyrovych Sushchenko is a Ukrainian journalist and artist. He was arrested in Russia on spying charges in 2016, and sentenced in 2018; his detention and sentence have been criticized by a number of Ukrainian and international agencies. Sushchenko was released in September 2019.
